# Background 
In this script, multivariable logistic regression is done to determine if Elevated AGP or Elevated calprotectin is associated with SVN when adjusting for the "normal" cofactors (BMI, age, etc.). 


## Packages

```{r Packages}

#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#  install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install()

#BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
library(phyloseq)

#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

#install.packages("here")
library(here)
```
## Data
```{r loading in data files}
#loading appropriate data files

load(here("results/filtered_dada_2_output_environment.RData"))

```


```{r Sample data to data frame}

sample_data <- ps_analysis_2@sam_data %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Sample.ID")

```



## Currated data

```{r birth outcomes data frame}
#combining large for gestational age into the "normal" category
#defining SVN to exclude those with miscarriages etc.
Birth_outcomes <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Born_Alive, Percential_weight.GA, Birth_weight_cat, GA_birth_binary, GA_birth, Birth_weight) %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA_2 = case_when(Percential_weight.GA == "normal" | Percential_weight.GA == "LGA" ~ "Normal", Percential_weight.GA == "SGA" ~ "SGA")) %>% 
   mutate(SVN = case_when(Percential_weight.GA_2 == "SGA" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = case_when(Born_Alive == "1" & Percential_weight.GA_2 == "Normal" & Birth_weight_cat == "Normal Weight" & GA_birth_binary == "Term" ~ "Healthy", Born_Alive == "1" & SVN == "SVN" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other"))

```

```{r Maternal Serology data frame}

Maternal_serology_inflammation <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, CRP_mg.L, Alpha1_AGP_ng.ml, calprotectin_ug.g, Ferritin_ng.ml, RBP4_ng.ml, Angiotensing_1_7_pg.ml, Angiotensin_II_pg.ml, inflammation_AGP_cat, inflammation_CRP_cat,inflammation) %>% 
  mutate(inflammation_calprotectin_cat = case_when(calprotectin_ug.g >= 50 ~ "Elevated Calprotectin", calprotectin_ug.g < 50 ~ "Normal Calprotectin")) %>%
  select(-calprotectin_ug.g)
#50 micrograms/gram as the cut off for normal/elevated calprotectin

```

```{r child info}

child <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Twins, Sex) %>% mutate(Sex = factor(Sex))

```

```{r cofactors}
#making sure each variable is considered as a "factor"
cofactors <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Maternal_age_cat, Maternal_education_cat, Parity_cat, Wealth_index, BMI_cat) %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_age_cat = factor(Maternal_age_cat, levels = c("<18", "18-35", ">35"))) %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_education_cat = factor(Maternal_education_cat, levels = c("No Education", "1-5", "6-10", ">10"))) %>% 
  mutate(Parity_cat = factor(Parity_cat, levels = c("0", "1-2", ">2"))) %>% 
  mutate(Wealth_index = factor(Wealth_index, levels = c("Poorest", "Poorer", "middle", "Ricehest", "Richer"))) %>% 
  mutate(BMI_cat = factor(BMI_cat, levels = c("Underweight", "Healthy Weight", "Overweight", "Obese")))


```

## Analysis

```{r regression SVN}
#combining data frames
regression_dataframe <- full_join(Birth_outcomes, Maternal_serology_inflammation) %>% 
  full_join(cofactors) %>% 
  full_join(child)
nrow(regression_dataframe) #237

#filtering out twins
regression_dataframe <- regression_dataframe %>% 
  filter(Twins == 2)
nrow(regression_dataframe) #235

#SVN
regression_dataframe_2 <- regression_dataframe %>%
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN == "Healthy" | Single_outcome_SVN == "SVN") %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = ifelse(Single_outcome_SVN == "SVN", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(inflammation_AGP_cat = factor(inflammation_AGP_cat, levels = c("Normal AGP", "Elevated AGP")))%>% 
  mutate(inflammation_calprotectin_cat = factor(inflammation_calprotectin_cat, levels = c("Normal Calprotectin", "Elevated Calprotectin")))

nrow(regression_dataframe_2) #213


table(regression_dataframe_2$inflammation_AGP_cat, regression_dataframe_2$Single_outcome_SVN)
table(regression_dataframe_2$Single_outcome_SVN)


#modeling SVN with cofactors and AGP
Model_SVN <- glm(Single_outcome_SVN ~ inflammation_AGP_cat + Maternal_age_cat + Maternal_education_cat + Parity_cat + Wealth_index + BMI_cat + Sex, data = regression_dataframe_2, family = binomial)
summary(Model_SVN)
exp(coef(Model_SVN))
confint(Model_SVN)
exp(confint(Model_SVN))


#Model_SVN_2 <- glm(Single_outcome_SVN ~ inflammation_AGP_cat, data = regression_dataframe_2, family = binomial)
#summary(Model_SVN_2)
#exp(coef(Model_SVN_2))
#confint(Model_SVN_2)
#exp(confint(Model_SVN_2))

#modeling SVN with cofactors and calprotectin
Model_SVN_3 <- glm(Single_outcome_SVN ~ inflammation_calprotectin_cat + Maternal_age_cat + Maternal_education_cat + Parity_cat + Wealth_index + BMI_cat + Sex, data = regression_dataframe_2, family = binomial)
summary(Model_SVN_3)
exp(coef(Model_SVN_3))
confint(Model_SVN_3)
exp(confint(Model_SVN_3))

```
